description.value:
You grant up to 8 willing creatures within range a hardened layer of air compressed to the point of becoming solid around their bodies. For the duration, each target gains resistance 10 to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, and force damage. Additionally, each target gains a +2 status bonus to recovery checks while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dying]{Dying}.

Heightened (+1) The resistance increases by 5.
